senses.gloss:
लुभ् r. 4th cl. (लुभ्यति) To desire, to covet. r. 6th cl. (लुभति)
 1. To be-
wilder, to perplex or delude.
 2. To desire eagerly.
 3. To allure.
With प्र or सम्, To attract or allure. Caus. (लोभयति-ते)
 1. To excite
desire.
 2. To attract.
 3. To excite lust.
 4. To disturb. With वि, 1.
To attract.
 2. To divert, to amuse.

लुभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perplexed, deluded, fascinated.
 E. लुभ् to fascinate, aff., क्त ।
